32 Orders before preparatory hearing.

(1) This section applies where—
(a) a judge orders a preparatory hearing, and
(b) he decides that any order which could be made under section 31(4) to (7) at
the hearing should be made before the hearing.

(2) In such a case—
(a) he may make any such order before the hearing (or at the hearing), and
(b) section 31(4) to (11) shall apply accordingly.

33 [F75Criminal Procedure Rules].

(1) [F76Criminal Procedure Rules ] may provide that except to the extent that disclosure
is required—
(a) by rules under section 81 of the M11Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984
(expert evidence), or
(b) by section 5(7) of this Act,
anything required to be given by an accused in pursuance of a requirement imposed
under section 31 need not disclose who will give evidence.
